card.name: Opening parenthesis before alternate names
card.fires_on: An opening parenthesis (or the first letter of an abbreviation inside it) right after a drug or disease name, where an alternate name or abbreviation follows. Typical cases are desmopressin (dDAVP), methylergometrine (methylergonovine), and hepatitis C virus (HCV).

modes.label: Parenthesis before alternate drug name
modes.description: The opening bracket after an ergot or similar drug name, introducing a synonym.

modes.label: Start of virus abbreviation
modes.description: The letter H starting HCV in parentheses after hepatitis C virus.
